verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship one. Nothing in Ghostty's evidence pack shows an integrated AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. AppleScript automation, Quick Look and libghostty are unrelated scripting, OS-integration and library features, not an AI assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
